tools.name: parseExcelFile
tools.description: Parses an uploaded Excel file in the standard CPI bulk-update format (columns: ArtifactId, ParameterKey, ParameterValue, Deploy). Returns a list of artifacts with their configuration parameters grouped by ArtifactId. Use this when the user has uploaded an Excel file and wants to review or apply its contents.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Original filename, used only for logging

tools.name: getSheetNames
tools.description: Returns the list of sheet names in an Excel workbook. Use this when the user wants to know what sheets are available before reading a specific one.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Absolute path to the Excel file

tools.name: readSheet
tools.description: Reads raw row data from a specific sheet in an Excel workbook and returns it as an array of JSON objects. Use this when the user wants to inspect the contents of a particular sheet.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Absolute path to the Excel file

parameters.name: sheetName
parameters.description: Name of the sheet to read. Defaults to the first sheet if omitted.
